_comment: Per-level feature selection, calibrated against parser/refdata/profile/map.json
(R's census) so a from-scratch build's per-level content counts land inside
harness.json's envelopes.count_ratio at levels 2..12 (level 0 exempt from the
road-link count ratio only -- background_count/name_count ARE checked at level 0
too, see parser/harness/checks/envelope.py's _COUNT_FIELDS). Format loaded by
parser/kiwiw/selection.py; see that module's docstring for the exact contract
and parser/tests/test_selection.py for the coverage/shape tests.
Calibration method: a lightweight tags-only osmium pass over
australia-260824.osm.pbf (no location index, no geometry, no parcel tiling --
~20-50s per full-file pass instead of unit 07's 1:27:24 full extraction) that
tallies national way/node counts per OSM class, cross-checked against
parser/refdata/profile/map.json's per-level counts. Background shapes are not
per way, centroid-assigned), so a national way count for an admitted class is
directly comparable to R's shape_count with no per-parcel-split correction.
Road links ARE split per parcel (split_polyline_by_parcel), so a national
admitted-highway-class way count under-approximates the real post-split link
count by an amount this table's own comment records per level -- see the
'calibration note' fields below and this unit's report for the full caveat.

rules._calibration_note: R link_count=9,897,898 (exempt from ratio at level 0, capacity-bound instead). Admitting the extractor's full ROADS set nationally: ~2,320,289 ways pre-split (matches output/spool/level_12.idx's pre-vocab roads=2,320,273 almost exactly, since level 12 has one global parcel with no splitting -- a useful cross-check). Real level-0 link count after parcel splitting was 3,015,057 in unit 07's original unfiltered spool, still well under R's count, so no further road restriction is needed for count purposes at level 0; unit 13's division and this table's implicit byte-size effect are what keep level-0 parcels under the capacity/u16 ceiling. Background: R background_count=9,445,322, envelope [4,722,661, 18,890,644] -- background_count/name_count ARE checked at level 0 (only link_count is level0-exempt, see parser/harness/checks/envelope.py). parser/refdata/vocab/bg_type.json declares a catch-all `{levels:0, match:{}, value:288}` rule, so at level 0 the real extractor already treats *every* non-road way with a ring as some background type regardless of tags; explicit key/value predicates cannot express that, so this rule sets background_all=true (dry-run cross-check: total_ways=11,464,956 minus ROADS-admitted=2,320,289 = 9,144,667 candidate non-road ways, ratio 0.968x -- centred in the envelope). Place: set to the full name-eligible set (_handle_node's own gate, osm_to_parcel_geometry.py:683) since that gate is stricter than this one anyway; place-node names are a small fraction of R's level-0 name_count=19,081,105 next to the ~2.3M dominant road-name driver already admitted via the highway list above.

R link_count=95,877, envelope [47,938.5, 191,754]. motorway+trunk+primary (no _link variants) = 14,004+67,557+85,859 = 167,420 ways nationally, ratio 1.75x -- inside the envelope on the raw way count. Real post-split link count will be somewhat higher (unit 07's level-0 split inflation was ~30% over its raw ROADS way count); if that inflation carries through here the ratio could approach or exceed the 2.0x ceiling -- flagged as an approximation risk in this unit's report, to be confirmed by 15b's real build.

R link_count=41,786, envelope [20,893, 83,572]. motorway+trunk = 14,004+67,557 = 81,561 ways, ratio 1.95x -- inside the envelope but close to the ceiling; same post-split inflation caveat as level 2, more likely to overshoot here.
R link_count=20,738, envelope [10,369, 41,476]. motorway alone = 14,004 ways, ratio 0.676x -- inside the envelope, with margin against post-split inflation.

R link_count=7,663, envelope [3,831.5, 15,326]. motorway alone = 14,004 ways, ratio 1.83x -- inside the envelope but close to the ceiling; no finer OSM class exists below 'motorway' to split this further, so this is the best achievable class-level selection (see report).

R link_count=0 (empty road_type_hist/display_class_hist in the profile) -- no highway class is admitted, matching R exactly. R background shape_count=25 with type_code composition {289: 6, 306: 11, 528: 8} (profile/map.json, levels.10.background.type_code_hist) -- see brief 24: unit 14's original choice, natural=dune (38 ways nationally, ratio 1.52x -- 'inside the envelope' on magnitude alone), was never reference-backed: R's real level-10/12 background vocabulary contains no natural/vegetation code at all, and bg_type.json has no rule (and deliberately no catch-all) for natural=dune at these levels, so every dune way silently mapped to bg_type=None and was dropped before spool.add -- levels 10/12 spooled zero background content despite selection admitting 38 candidate ways. Brief 24's fix: re-selected to natural=bay, the only bg_type.json-mapped tag (of the full 289 source set -- natural=coastline/bay/sea/ocean/water/wetland/river/stream, waterway=river/stream/canal) whose national way count lands near R's target. Per-tag national counts (this unit's tags-only osmium pass over australia-260824.osm.pbf): natural=coastline 16,516; natural=water 291,701; natural=wetland 43,704; waterway=stream 642,632; waterway=river 45,400; waterway=canal 13,884 -- every one of these overshoots the [12.5, 50] envelope (0.5x-2.0x of 25) by 2-3 orders of magnitude if admitted alongside natural=bay, so only natural=bay is admitted. natural=bay = 26 ways nationally, ratio 1.04x -- centred in the envelope, and (unlike dune) a real member of bg_type.json's existing 289 rule, so this content now actually reaches spool.add. This does not attempt boundary=administrative (306) or the road-as-background share (528, still explicitly out of scope, see vocab/README.md): a full national tags-only scan found boundary=administrative ways carry admin_level=2 (73, the national-boundary segments) or no admin_level tag at all (6) -- zero ways nationally carry admin_level=4, the exact predicate bg_type.json's 306 rule requires. This is a structural finding, not a selection-tuning one: Australian state/territory boundaries are modelled as OSM relations (boundary=administrative, admin_level=4 on the *relation*), and osm_to_parcel_geometry.py's own docstring records that 'multi-polygon OSM relations are handled as individual outer-ring ways only' -- the member ways carry no admin_level tag of their own. Admitting boundary=administrative here would repeat exactly the dune bug (selected but bg_type.json-unmappable, since no way ever carries admin_level=4) rather than fix it, so it is deliberately left out; see vocab/README.md's Levels 10/12 section for the full writeup. R name record_count=8, all type_code 308 = 0x134, which osm_to_parcel_geometry._handle_node only ever assigns when place=='suburb' -- so R's 8 level-10/12 name records are place=suburb nodes. But _handle_node itself (osm_to_parcel_geometry.py:683) only calls level_filter for place in {suburb,city,town,village,locality} in the first place, so any other 'place' value here (an earlier draft used place=territory, matching a raw node tag census by coincidence -- 9 hits nationally, ratio 1.125x) is dead code: it can never admit a name record, because that upstream gate discards everything else before level_filter is even consulted. The only real lever is place=suburb itself, but its national count is 4,233 (this unit's node tag-count scan) -- ratio 529x over the [4,16] envelope around R's target of 8. No tags-only rule (this format has no population= threshold or explicit place-name allowlist) can hit 8 without either drastically overshooting (admit suburb) or landing at 0 (admit nothing); left at 0 here as the smaller of two bad options and reported as an unresolved shortfall per this unit's brief (report, don't pad with a guess).

Same as level 10 (brief 24's fix): R link_count=0 (this is the level the amendment flags as load-bearing for unit 13's u16/capacity ceiling -- level 12 is one global parcel with no per-cell tiling, so zero admitted roads here is required, not just census-matched). Background selection mirrors level 10's -- natural=bay, ratio 1.04x, replacing the previous natural=dune (which was admitted by selection but never mapped by bg_type.json, so it silently dropped and spooled zero content; see level 10's note for the full national tag-count table and the boundary=administrative/306 finding, which applies identically here). Place: same unreachable-target finding as level 10 -- R's 8 name records are place=suburb (type_code 0x134); the national place=suburb count is 4,233, ~529x over the [4,16] envelope; any place value other than the 5 osm_to_parcel_geometry._handle_node itself recognises is dead code (never reaches level_filter). Left empty, reported as an unresolved shortfall.
